body: clientInfo.hp/maxHP raw ints replaced with hpState *combatTp.HPState, reusing the already-tested type (17 existing tests upstream) instead of re-deriving damage-floor/KO logic by hand. PacketWSCast now rejects casting from a KO'd caster and casting at an already-KO'd target. Deliberately not implemented: any respawn/home-point flow once killed=true fires -- apps2/mud's own knockOut() leaves a player waiting until they type home or get Raised; porting that is separate, larger follow-up work, named honestly. go build/test clean. Commit 2295009.
title: apps2/server-go gets real KO state via server/combat.HPState
